decisions.reason: Rendering tutorial text separately is compatible with the existing full-app localization requirement and does not change its current localization obligation or scope.
The tutorial asset strategy does not alter the existing requirement to localize full iOS app content; it specifies media delivery under the source Requirement.
Reusable tutorial backgrounds may support size optimization, but the source decision does not change the existing Android size-minimization goal or make any current attribute obsolete.
The tutorial image and text delivery strategy has no effect on Android permission policy or removal of READ_PHONE_STATE.
The tutorial asset strategy may contribute to a smaller package, but it does not change the existing iOS optimization goal or invalidate any current attribute.
Separating tutorial backgrounds from translatable text does not change the iOS framework modernization, deprecated-API, or maintainability requirements.
The tutorial rendering strategy does not affect the requirement to provide an iOS Privacy Manifest.
The tutorial asset and text strategy has no effect on iOS signing certificates or signing configuration.
Rendering tutorial text separately does not itself establish or change any right-to-left layout behavior; the existing RTL requirement remains unchanged.
